integrity: The formulas and proof are fully included. Checker checks finite spectral moments and scaling but is not a substitute for the proof. No independent audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly weighted critical Fourier interpolation on a symmetric three-periodic sampling pattern, with consecutive frequencies and sizes divisible by three; no assertion for arbitrary node perturbations.
title: Three-band rigidity and a sharp triple-collision law for periodic Fourier interpolation
